description: Breguet 765 Sahara, one of only three surviving Breguet Deux-Ponts. Stands at the entrance to BA 105 beside the RN 13 and has been under restoration by the association Le Deux-Ponts de l'Eure since about 1997; carried the code 64-PE. Confirmed present January and March 2024.
On a plinth on the base; repainted from three-tone camouflage back into natural metal and white in autumn 2016.
Stored for years at Nantes, arrived at Évreux in 2017 for restoration and static display; restored by the association Le Deux-Ponts de l'Eure.

Nose section only, displayed in front of the entrance to the Escadron electronique aeroporte 1/54 Dunkerque. This airframe was a Noratlas Gabriel and was previously in the fire section area at Cazaux.

Transall C-160NG erected as a stele beside the Breguet Deux-Ponts in late August 2021; individual number not published in the sources consulted. Seen in good condition on an AAMA visit of 27 March 2024.
Cockpit section only, displayed inside the base museum for visitors to sit in; individual number not published in the sources consulted. Seen 27 March 2024.
